evals.prompt: Any media buying or advertising tenders open right now?
evals.expected_output: Runs bdleads list with --agency media/ad and --kind tender; reports what is open with deadline and a source link per lead; if nothing matches says so plainly before broadening; no invented tenders or organisations.

evals.prompt: Which banks changed their CEO recently? We want to pitch the new heads.
evals.expected_output: Uses --kind corporate_announcement --signal leadership_change --sector banking_finance; lists BankIslami and NBP filings with dates and PSX links; does not add names or details not in the filing titles.

evals.prompt: I saw on LinkedIn that a dairy brand hired a new CMO, can you log it?
evals.expected_output: Asks for the post URL and the post text if missing; uses bdleads add with a verbatim excerpt; does not write the excerpt from memory.
